status: ILLUSTRATION -- NOT A TEST OF THE FRONTIER
note: Z is four noisy copies of M, so the residual is exactly -gamma and eps -> 0.9*beta by algebra. The frontier location and the reported coverage are consequences of the data-generating process, not measurements. See frontier_sweep.py for the real experiment.

recovery.coverage_caveat: with the archived IN-POOL interpolated radius this coverage is a function of n alone (0.90 at n=400) and carries no information; the leave-one-out radius used here at least lets it vary.

frontier.why_this_is_not_evidence: the transition sits at |M| ~ eps and eps ~ 0.9*beta because the residual IS gamma ~ U(-beta,beta) by construction; the plot restates the DGP.

fa_by_beta_caveat: eps ~ 0.9*beta in every row because gamma ~ U(-beta,beta) was drawn that way. The 'eps self-calibrates to beta' panel is a plot of our own generator.
